title: Court Records & Case Law Scraper input

query.title: Search query
query.description: Full-text search across case names, party/attorney names, docket text and opinion bodies. Supports quoted phrases ("fair use") and boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT). Leave empty to browse everything matching the other filters.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: Which CourtListener index to search. Dockets are the PACER/RECAP mirror (federal case dockets with parties, attorneys and filing entries). Opinions are published court decisions with citations. They are separate indexes — a case in one is often absent from the other.

courts.title: Courts
courts.description: CourtListener court IDs — the short slug in a courtlistener.com/court/<id>/ URL. Examples: "scotus" (Supreme Court), "ca9" (9th Circuit), "cand" (N.D. Cal.), "cacb" (Bankr. C.D. Cal.), "nysd" (S.D.N.Y.). 400+ federal and state courts exist. Leave empty for all courts. An unrecognised ID is not rejected upstream — it silently matches nothing.

filedAfter.title: Filed after
filedAfter.description: Earliest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for no lower bound (the opinion archive reaches back to the 1700s).

filedBefore.title: Filed before
filedBefore.description: Latest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for no upper bound.

opinionStatus.title: Opinion status
opinionStatus.description: Opinions mode only. CourtListener's opinion index defaults to PUBLISHED opinions only when this is left as-is — verified live on a real query, unpublished opinions are ~26% of matches and are silently absent unless you ask for them. "Any" returns both.

startUrl.title: CourtListener search URL
startUrl.description: Optional shortcut: build the search on courtlistener.com, then paste the address bar here — e.g. "https://www.courtlistener.com/?q=patent&type=r&court=cand&filed_after=2024-01-01". An API URL ("https://www.courtlistener.com/api/rest/v4/search/?q=patent&type=o") works too — both use the same parameters. Whatever the URL mentions (search query, court(s), filed-after/before dates, stat_Published/stat_Unpublished checkboxes) REPLACES the matching field below; anything it doesn't mention still comes from the fields below. Only Opinions (type=o) and RECAP (type=r) URLs are supported — CourtListener's Oral Arguments/Judges/Parenthetical searches are different record shapes this Actor does not cover. Max results and the watch label always apply regardless.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many records. With recordType "both" the budget is shared across the two indexes (opinions first, then dockets).

watchLabel.title: Watch label (incremental mode)
watchLabel.description: Optional. Name this saved search to get ONLY records that are new since its last run. The first run on a label records the current matches as a baseline and returns zero results (you are charged nothing); every run after that returns only what appeared since. Changing any filter starts a fresh baseline under the same label. Leave empty for a normal one-off run.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (notify on completion)
webhookUrl.description: Optional. An http(s) URL to POST a small JSON summary to when the run finishes — records pushed, rows scanned, pages fetched, CourtListener's own reported total, watch-label new count if Watch label is set, and the run's dataset ID so you can fetch the results. A convenience for callers who want a completion ping without setting up an Apify platform webhook (which needs separate Console/API configuration per Task, not per run). Best-effort: a failed or slow webhook is logged as a warning and never fails the run or affects charging — it fires after every record has already been pushed and charged. Leave empty to skip.
